anomalies.message: CPU load average is consistently above the number of cores, indicating potential overutilization.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, indicating it may not be functioning correctly.
Trading system shows no active trades or profit/loss activity, suggesting potential inactivity or misconfiguration.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load average.
Review AI module to ensure it is configured and functioning correctly to generate trading opportunities.
Evaluate trading strategies and configurations to ensure they are set up to execute trades effectively.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough review of CPU usage to identify and address any processes causing high load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system slowdowns and affect trading platform performance, potentially impacting user experience and trading efficiency.

recommendations.action: Perform diagnostics on the AI system to ensure it is operational and capable of generating trading insights.
recommendations.rationale: The AI system is not contributing to trading decisions, which could limit the platform's ability to capitalize on market opportunities.

recommendations.action: Audit trading configurations and strategies to ensure they are active and aligned with market conditions.
recommendations.rationale: Inactive trading could result from misconfigurations or strategy issues, leading to missed opportunities in the market.
